method: image_edit from both DragonWake references (north-star settlement screenshot and AlphaDesign painting), then Pillow+numpy plate key. No rembg. Not promoted into apps/web/public.

assets.name: wilderness-camp
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated wilderness camp: sharpened timber palisade, two weathered canvas tents, cook fire with iron pot, mud and moss. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, small contact shadow, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot.
defects: Irregular mud-and-moss footprint instead of a hard plot plinth.
Long plate-cast shadow removed with the key; only shading inside the mud remains.
Extra camp props (crate, small stump) inside the ring; palisade has an entrance gap.
Ground edge is a warm brown feather. Measured edge magenta-excess p90 is 0 after despill.

assets.name: timber-stand
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated worked woodlot: stacked felled logs, axe-marked stump, cut rounds, timber sawhorse, mud and muted moss. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot.
defects: Sawhorse can read as a low bench.
Mossy ground disc is wide relative to the logs.
Long plate-cast shadow removed; contact shading stays in the dirt.
Faint warm rim on the moss edge, not a magenta matte (edge magenta-excess p90 is 0).

assets.name: ore-outcrop
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated iron outcrop: dark rust-streaked rock, iron pickaxe with wooden haft, two woven baskets of ore on mud. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot. One retry: first pass had a blade-like tool on a rose plate.
defects: Retry plate is still rose ~(165, 53, 107), not pure #FF00FF. Keyed from the sampled corner with a chroma-ratio band 0.30–0.46 plus a rose-excess gate above ~32. A pure-magenta distance would not have removed the plate.
Charcoal ore was not eaten; low-luminance pixels far from the plate were protected.
Long cast shadow removed. Mud footprint kept.

assets.name: stone-quarry
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated stone quarry: cut weathered block face, stacked dressed blocks, dark timber brace, chips and mud. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot.
defects: Reads as a braced stack of cut blocks more than a deep excavated pit.
Gray stone was not eaten (subject magenta-excess stayed near or below 0).
Long plate-cast shadow removed; thin warm fringe on the gravel edge only.

assets.name: grain-plot
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated fenced grain plot with tied golden-ochre shocks on muddy paths. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot. One retry: first pass was standing grain rows, not shocks.
defects: Plate sampled ~(198, 23, 196), darker than pure #FF00FF. Keyed by magenta-excess (opaque below ~16, gone above ~40), not by distance to #FF00FF.
Nine repetitive shock silhouettes; awn tips are slightly rosy but are not a plate leak.
Near fence corner is open, like a gap rather than a closed gate.
Long plate-cast shadow removed.

assets.name: watch-outpost
assets.prompt_summary: Single isolated ruined watch shed of weathered stone and dark timber, sagging roof, torn green banner rag, empty of creatures. Three-quarter isometric, warm upper-left light, flat magenta plate. Materials and light of the references, not a copy of the castle poster or the UI screenshot.
defects: No coast or water in the frame (water was disallowed on the plate), so it reads as a ruined shed rather than a cliffside watch.
Open roof and missing walls are transparent holes. That is the plate showing through the ruin, not deleted geometry.
Green rag is dull olive, not a saturated faction banner.
No dragon. Long plate-cast shadow removed. Gray stone was not eaten.
